title: Unit 1 : The Gifts of Youth and Creativity

items.title: Youth qualities and potential : vigor, passion, creativity, innovation, and perseverance
items.description: Stereotypes about youth (rebellious, careless) contrasted with their real civic contributions.

items.title: Text Analysis : Young Moroccan inventors and social entrepreneurs making global impact
items.description: Vocabulary acquisition : ambition, initiative, breakthrough, empowerment, and self-esteem.

items.title: Gerund vs Infinitive advanced patterns and prepositions followed by -ing
items.description: Common phrases : look forward to + ing, be used to + ing, succeed in + ing.

items.title: Language Functions : Expressing Complaint and Apologizing sincerely
items.description: Formal and informal ways to lodge a complaint and respond constructively.

sections.name: Psychological and Cultural Dimensions of Humour

items.title: Humour styles : slapstick, satire, irony, puns, and psychological health benefits of laughter
items.description: Idiomatic expressions related to laughter : 'burst into tears', 'crack up', 'die of laughter'.

items.title: Grammar : Modals of Past Deduction and Regret (must have, can't have, should have + past participle)
items.description: Expressing logical certainty about the past and expressing moral regret for past mistakes.

title: Unit 3 : Sustainable Development and Environmental Ecology

items.title: Sustainable development goals (SDGs) : renewable energies, reforestation, waste management, and solar power
items.description: Morocco's global leadership in clean energy : Noor Ouarzazate Solar Complex and wind farms.

items.title: Grammar : Phrasal Verbs with multi-word verbs (look after, give up, run out of, carry on)
items.description: Transitive and intransitive phrasal verbs, separable and inseparable verbs in English sentences.

sections.name: Formal Writing : Cause and Effect Essay

items.title: Structuring a Cause and Effect Essay on Environmental Pollution
items.description: Writing introductory hooks, background information, thesis statements, cause/effect body paragraphs, and actionable conclusions.

title: Unit 4 : Women and Power : Gender Equality and Leadership

items.title: Women's empowerment, closing the gender gap, and female political participation
items.description: Moroccan women pioneers in science, sports, business, and human rights advocacy.

items.title: Grammar : The Passive Voice across all tenses (Continuous, Perfect, and Modal verbs)
items.description: Transformation rules : Subject + auxiliary be + past participle + (by agent).

title: Unit 5 : Cultural Values, Citizenship, and Diversity

items.title: Civic duties and constitutional rights, volunteering, solidarity, and countering discrimination
items.description: Understanding stereotypes, prejudices, tolerance, and peaceful dialogue between civilizations.

items.title: Grammar : Reported Speech (Direct to Indirect Speech) : Statements, Questions, and Commands
items.description: Backshift of tenses, adjustments of pronouns, and time/place adverbs (now -> then, today -> that day).

title: Unit 6 : Advances in Science, AI, and Technology

items.title: Artificial Intelligence, biotechnology, space exploration, and cyber security challenges
items.description: Pros and cons of technological automation and the ethical boundaries of genetic engineering.

items.title: Grammar : Conditionals Type 2 and Type 3, and Expressing Wishes and Regrets
items.description: Unreal present conditionals (If I were you...), unreal past conditionals (If I had known...), and 'I wish / If only' constructions.

title: Unit 7 : Brain Drain and International Migration

items.title: Causes and consequences of highly skilled migration from developing countries
items.description: Push factors (lack of research funding, low salaries) and pull factors (high living standards, better facilities), and strategies to turn Brain Drain into Brain Gain.

items.title: Preparation for the National Baccalaureate Examination : Reading, Language & Writing
items.description: Intensive drills on past exam papers, error correction, sentence completion, and argumentative essay writing.
